title: Input `is_action_released` event gets passed through to `_unhandled_input` when control gets hidden
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Fedora Linux 42 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT (radeonsi, navi22, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.17.4-200.fc42.x86_64) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K (28 threads) - 62.54 GiB memory

### Issue description

In a RPG prototype we have a "PlayerController" that uses `_unhandled_input` to react to mouse clicks and interact with the game world, issue character movement commands, etc. Additionally there are some GUI elements to manage equipment, move inventory items. What we noticed is that in some cases input events over the GUI can unexpectedly pass through to `_unhandled_input` causing unwanted interactions with the game world.

Specifically when a `TextureRect` that's part of a `Panel` handles a left click press in `gui_input` and then becomes invisible the left click release passes through to `_unhandled_input`. Left clicks directly on the panel never pass through.

### Steps to reproduce

``` GDScript
# this gui_input handler on `TextureRect` 
func _on_icon_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("left_click"):
		texture_rect.visible = false

# causes this one to fire, can be on any node
func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_released("left_click"):
		print("InputHandler _unhandled_input: Click released at %s" % event.position)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP_unhandled-input-action-released.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23235466/MRP_unhandled-input-action-released.zip)
